register.name: Reshumot / Sefer HaChukim (רשומות, ספר החוקים), published by the Knesset; consolidated working text from "The Open Book of Laws" (ספר החוקים הפתוח) on Hebrew Wikisource
register.access_notes: Israel has no free official consolidated register: the official text of a Law is its original Sefer HaChukim publication plus every amending Act, each its own Reshumot issue. Work done for this group: ~20 requests to he.wikisource.org (rendered pages and action=raw wikitext for each Act, plus one namespace search and the Copyright Act page), spaced about 2 seconds apart, all HTTP 200. Every Act's Wikisource header carries a {{ח:תיבה}} citation box giving the ס״ח issue/page and a direct link to the Knesset's fs.knesset.gov.il PDF of that issue, so the official citations and PDF URLs recorded below were read off the register's own citation boxes rather than inferred. One official PDF was fetched to confirm it resolves: https://fs.knesset.gov.il/18/law/18_lsr_301013.pdf returned HTTP 200, application/pdf, 202 KB, but this environment has no PDF rasteriser so its cover page could not be read; its ס״ח תשע״ב page 414 heading was, however, visible in a search engine's index of that same PDF. The Knesset legislation database page for the Aviation Services Law (main.knesset.gov.il/Activity/Legislation/Laws/Pages/LawPrimary.aspx?t=lawlaws&st=lawlaws&lawitemid=2001417) returned HTTP 200 with an empty body — it is a JavaScript application, not a block. The Civil Aviation Authority's own page for that Law, https://www.gov.il/he/pages/aviation-services-law, returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; that is a block, it was not worked around, and it is the reason the current-year compensation figures below are flagged for human confirmation.

licence.summary: No copyright subsists in Israeli statutes: Copyright Act, 5768-2007 (חוק זכות יוצרים, התשס״ח–2007), s 6, denies copyright in laws, regulations, Knesset records and judicial decisions. The statutory text is therefore freely reusable. The Wikisource wrapping (page structure, editorial notes, cross-reference templates) is contributed material under CC BY-SA, so credit the Open Book of Laws for the consolidation even though the law itself is unencumbered.

acts.title: Insurance Contract Law, 5741-1981
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5741 (ס״ח תשמ״א), p 94; Wikisource page: חוק חוזה הביטוח
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק חוזה הביטוח; the heading prints the title as חוק חוזה הביטוח, התשמ״א–1981. The header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשמ״א, 94|חוק חוזה הביטוח|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/9/law/9_lsr_208385.pdf}}, i.e. Sefer HaChukim 5741 p 94, enacted 28 Shevat 5741 (2 February 1981). Section 75(a) sets commencement at 6 Tevet 5742 (1 January 1982), with a three-month deferral for s 28(a) — so the whole Law has long been in force. Highest-year amendment box in the wikitext is ס״ח תשפ״ד, 160 (Amendment No 9 to the Adjudication of Interest and Linkage Law), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_3568695.pdf, published 13 November 2023. Consolidation last edited 8 September 2026.
acts.notes: This is the general contract-law statute for insurance: formation, disclosure, the insurer's duties on notification of a loss, time limits and payment of indemnity. It is the right core instrument for an insurance-claims encoding. Two things a human should weigh before encoding: (1) insurer conduct on claims handling is also regulated administratively under the Supervision of Financial Services (Insurance) Law, 5741-1981 (חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (ביטוח)) and the Capital Market Authority Commissioner's circulars, which were NOT verified in this pass; (2) the Law is a Knesset Law, not a Mandate-era Ordinance, and is not part of any code, although it sits alongside the other contract statutes that the draft Civil Code project has long proposed to consolidate — no replacement Act is in force.

acts.title: Road Accident Victims Compensation Law, 5735-1975
acts.title_he: חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים, תשל״ה–1975
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5735 (ס״ח תשל״ה), p 234; Wikisource page: חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים; the heading prints the title as חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים, תשל״ה–1975 (note: printed without the definite-article prefix ה before תשל״ה, unlike the later Laws in this file — recorded as printed). Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשל״ה, 234|חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/8/law/8_lsr_209261.pdf}}. Commencement 1 Tishrei 5737 (25 September 1976). The Law establishes the statutory compensation fund (קרן לפיצוי נפגעי תאונות דרכים) as a legal person, which is operative. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ד, 1491 (Amendment No 13 to the Protection of Privacy Law), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_4810658.pdf. Consolidation last edited 16 December 2025.
acts.notes: The no-fault strict-liability regime for personal injury in a road accident: it displaces tort claims for bodily injury, caps and structures heads of damage, and routes uninsured/untraced cases to the Karnit fund. It is the second statute a person with an Israeli insurance claim is actually governed by, so it belongs next to the Insurance Contract Law. A human should decide whether the compulsory-insurance side, פקודת ביטוח רכב מנועי [נוסח חדש], תש״ל–1970 (Motor Vehicle Insurance Ordinance [New Version]) — a Mandate-derived Ordinance in New Version form — should be added as a third Act; it was NOT fetched or verified in this pass and must be checked against the register before being relied on.

acts.title: Electricity Sector Law, 5756-1996
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5756 (ס״ח תשנ״ו), p 208; Wikisource page: חוק משק החשמל
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק משק החשמל; heading prints חוק משק החשמל, התשנ״ו–1996. Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשנ״ו, 208|חוק משק החשמל|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/13/law/13_lsr_211303.pdf}}. Commencement: most provisions from 13 Adar 5756 (4 March 1996), the penal provisions from the date of publication. Confirmed on the page that the billing machinery is in this Law and not elsewhere: s 30 (תפקידי הרשות, functions of the Electricity Authority, tariff-setting first among them), s 31 (קביעת תעריפים), s 31א (תשלומים מופחתים, reduced payments), s 32 (עדכון התעריפים), and s 17(c) obliging an essential-service licensee to collect payments in accordance with Authority tariffs. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ה, 688 (Amendment No 20), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_7458915.pdf. Consolidation last edited 15 July 2026.
acts.notes: Chosen over חוק החשמל. The candidate list offered either or both; I fetched חוק החשמל, תשי״ד–1954 (ס״ח תשי״ד, 190, Wikisource page חוק החשמל, last amended 5785, page last edited 30 December 2025) and confirmed from the page itself that it is an occupational-licensing and electrical-installation-safety statute — licensing of electricians, technicians and electrical engineers — with no provisions on tariffs, consumer billing or disconnection. It is therefore the wrong instrument for this topic and is deliberately excluded. Caveat for the encoder: the Electricity Sector Law sets the framework and the Authority's tariff power, but the operative detail of consumer billing, metering, deposits, arrears and disconnection lives in the Electricity Authority's rules (כללי משק החשמל) made under it — subordinate legislation, not statute. An encoding of billing rights from the statute alone will be thin.

acts.title: Water and Sewage Corporations Law, 5761-2001
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5761 (ס״ח תשס״א), p 454; Wikisource page: חוק תאגידי מים וביוב
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק תאגידי מים וביוב; heading prints חוק תאגידי מים וביוב, התשס״א–2001. Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשס״א, 454|חוק תאגידי מים וביוב|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/15/law/15_lsr_300397.pdf}}. Confirmed the charging provisions on the page: סימן ז׳: קביעת כללים לחישוב עלות ותעריפים (rules for cost calculation and tariffs), s 102 as the tariff-setting power, and ss 31 and 33 obliging a corporation to supply water and sewage services in accordance with tariffs set under s 102, without discrimination and subject to the service standards under s 99. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ו, 286 (Amendment No 19), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_11338829.pdf.
acts.notes: This is the instrument a household water bill is issued under: since the reform, municipal water and sewage supply is run by corporations licensed under this Law, charging tariffs set by the Water Authority under s 102. Two cautions. (1) Partial future commencement: the consolidation shows amendment provisions keyed to a מועד קובע (determining date) of 22 Tevet 5787 (1 January 2027), so some of the current text is future-dated and an encoder must pin an as-at date. (2) As with electricity, the billing detail — meter readings, consumption bands, arrears, restriction of supply — is set out in Water Authority rules (כללי תאגידי מים וביוב) made under the Law rather than in the Law itself. The Wikisource page's last-edited timestamp was not exposed in the rendered header; the ס״ח תשפ״ו, 286 amendment box is the best currency marker recorded.

acts.title: Aviation Services Law (Compensation and Assistance for Flight Cancellation or Change of Conditions), 5772-2012
acts.title_he: חוק שירותי תעופה (פיצוי וסיוע בשל ביטול טיסה או שינוי בתנאיה), התשע״ב–2012
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5772 (ס״ח תשע״ב), p 414; Wikisource page: חוק שירותי תעופה (פיצוי וסיוע בשל ביטול טיסה או שינוי בתנאיה); Knesset legislation database item 2001417
acts.verified_how: Verified harder than the rest, as instructed. Fetched the Wikisource rendered page, its full raw wikitext, and the raw wikitext of its lead section. Page title is exactly חוק שירותי תעופה (פיצוי וסיוע בשל ביטול טיסה או שינוי בתנאיה); heading prints ...,‏ התשע״ב–2012. Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשע״ב, 414|חוק שירותי תעופה (פיצוי וסיוע בשל ביטול טיסה או שינוי בתנאיה)|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/18/law/18_lsr_301013.pdf}}; that PDF was fetched directly and returned HTTP 200 / application/pdf / 202 KB, and its heading line "414 ... חוק שירותי תעופה (פיצוי וסיוע בשל ביטול טיסה או שינוי בתנאיה) התשע\"ב—2012" is visible in a search engine's index of the same PDF, corroborating page 414. Commencement 16 August 2012. Amendment boxes found, with their own official PDFs: ס״ח תש״ף, 224 (https://fs.knesset.gov.il/23/law/23_lsr_576534.pdf); ס״ח תש״ף, 376 (https://fs.knesset.gov.il/23/law/23_lsr_580278.pdf); ס״ח תשפ״א, 138 (https://fs.knesset.gov.il/23/law/23_lsr_592590.pdf); and the most recent, ס״ח תשפ״ה, 304 (https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_5694585.pdf). Consolidation last edited 5 February 2026. Schedules: three, headed תוספת ראשונה, תוספת שנייה and תוספת שלישית in the wikitext. The lead section carries an unbroken run of annual amount-update notices in Yalkut HaPirsumim from י״פ תשע״ג, 1941 through י״פ תשפ״ו, 3641 — fourteen consecutive years, which is itself good evidence the Law is live and administered. Two official corroborating sources could not be read: the Knesset database page for item 2001417 returned an empty body (JavaScript application), and the Civil Aviation Authority page https://www.gov.il/he/pages/aviation-services-law returned HTTP 403 Forbidden and was not worked around.
acts.notes: The strongest passenger-compensation statute in the corpus, and structurally close to EU Regulation 261/2004 but not identical. Encoding notes. FIRST SCHEDULE (תוספת ראשונה): flat cash compensation in three flight-distance bands — up to 2,000 km, up to 4,500 km, and over 4,500 km — with enacted base amounts of NIS 1,250 / 2,000 / 3,000. These are NOT constants: the Law indexes them, updating on 1 January each year by the ratio of the consumer price index and rounding to the nearest NIS 10, and the update is published as a Yalkut HaPirsumim notice. The figures the consolidation shows as current for 2026 are NIS 1,530 / 2,450 / 3,670, per the notice at י״פ תשפ״ו, 3641. A HUMAN MUST CONFIRM those three current-year figures against the official Yalkut notice or the Civil Aviation Authority before they are relied on, because the CAA's own page was 403 and the figures above come only from the unofficial consolidation. Model the schedule as an indexed table keyed by effective year, not as three literals. SECOND SCHEDULE: downgrade compensation expressed as percentages of the ticket price (roughly 60%-100%, varying by cabin-class change and distance). THIRD SCHEDULE: imputed ticket prices for package tours, across the same three distance bands and three service classes (the 2026 top figure shown is NIS 15,300), also indexed. Separately, s 9א, added by ס״ח תשפ״ה, 304, empowers the Minister to modify entitlements during a declared state of emergency lasting more than 14 days — a live derogation power that any faithful encoding has to represent, and the 5780/5781 amendments were the COVID-era analogue. Do not treat this Law as a translation of EU 261: bands, amounts, the assistance duties and the emergency derogation all differ.

acts.title: Hire and Loan Law, 5731-1971
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5731 (ס״ח תשל״א), p 160; residential-lease chapter inserted by ס״ח תשע״ז, 1028; Wikisource page: חוק השכירות והשאילה
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק השכירות והשאילה; heading prints חוק השכירות והשאילה, תשל״א–1971 (again printed without the ה prefix before תשל״א). Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשל״א, 160|חוק השכירות והשאילה|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/7/law/7_lsr_209679.pdf}}. Commencement 1 January 1972. Confirmed the Fair Rent material is here and is a chapter of this Law: the heading סימן ו׳: חוזה שכירות למגורים covers ss 25א to 25טו, inserted by the 5777 amendment whose citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|תשע״ז, 1028|תיקון|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/20/law/20_lsr_389390.pdf}}. Read the chapter's own application provision: it applies to a lease conferring a right of tenancy in an apartment for residential purposes. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ו, 362, the Economic Programme Law for budget year 2026, https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_12224370.pdf. Consolidation last edited 14 June 2026.
acts.notes: THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT THAT GOVERNS AN ORDINARY RESIDENTIAL TENANCY IN ISRAEL TODAY — specifically סימן ו׳ (ss 25א-25טו), the chapter popularly called the Fair Rent Law (חוק שכירות הוגנת), added in 2017 by ס״ח תשע״ז, 1028. It sets the habitability standard for a let apartment, allocates repair responsibility, limits the security a landlord may take, and restricts charging the tenant the landlord's own costs. The general Parts of the Law (ss 1-25) supply the background hire regime for everything the chapter does not cover, and the same Law also covers loan/bailment (שאילה). The chapter's own exclusions, read off the consolidation, are: hotel and holiday apartments; residential care and sheltered-housing units; student and employee dormitories; premises under the Tenants' Protection Law; leases of under three months with no renewal option; leases of over ten years with no early-termination option; and high-rent apartments, with the threshold shown in the consolidation as monthly rent above NIS 20,000. A human should confirm that NIS 20,000 threshold and whether it is indexed, since it is the boundary of the whole protective chapter and was read from the unofficial consolidation.

acts.title: Tenants' Protection Law [Consolidated Version], 5732-1972
acts.identifier: Sefer HaChukim 5732 (ס״ח תשל״ב), p 176 — the נוסח משולב (consolidated version); the underlying original is חוק הגנת הדייר at ס״ח תשי״ד, 92. Wikisource page: חוק הגנת הדייר
acts.verified_how: The obvious page name חוק הגנת הדייר [נוסח משולב] returns HTTP 404 on Wikisource; found the real page by a namespace-0 search on he.wikisource.org, which returned חוק הגנת הדייר and a separate חוק הגנת הדייר (מוסדות ציבור), plus six sets of תקנות הגנת הדייר. Fetched the page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק הגנת הדייר; the heading prints the full title as חוק הגנת הדייר [נוסח משולב], תשל״ב–1972, and the rendered header attributes the consolidated version to ס״ח תשל״ב, 176. Note honestly: the FIRST citation box in the wikitext is {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשי״ד, 92|חוק הגנת הדייר|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/2/law/2_lsr_211796.pdf}}, which is the 1954 Law as originally published, not the 1972 consolidated version — so the official_url recorded above is the 1954 publication and a separate Reshumot PDF for ס״ח תשל״ב, 176 was not located. Section 162 of the consolidated version sets its commencement at 1 Cheshvan 5733 (9 October 1972). Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ג, 21, https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_1783627.pdf. Consolidation last edited 28 December 2025. On scope, read ss 9 and 10: both turn on whether premises had an entitled tenant on 26 Av 5728 — the text opens "נכס שביום כ״ו באב תשכ״ח (20 באוגוסט 1968)" — excluding premises vacant on that date unless later let with key money.
acts.notes: OPERATIVE BUT RESIDUAL, AND NOT THE RIGHT INSTRUMENT FOR AN ORDINARY RESIDENTIAL TENANCY. It has not been repealed and is still applied, but only to protected tenancies (דיירות מוגנת) — overwhelmingly legacy key-money tenancies, plus rent-controlled business premises, with the ss 9-10 gateway tied to the position on 20 August 1968 and to key money having been paid. A tenant who signs a residential lease in Israel today is governed by סימן ו׳ of the Hire and Loan Law, 5731-1971, not by this Law; indeed the Fair Rent chapter expressly excludes premises that are under this Law, which is the clearest textual confirmation that the two regimes are disjoint. Keep it in the corpus because protected tenancies are still litigated and because the exclusion in the Hire and Loan Law cannot be encoded without it — but do not let it stand as the tenancy statute. Much of its operative detail (permitted rents for business premises, repairs, service charges) is in the six sets of תקנות הגנת הדייר made under it, which are subordinate legislation and were not verified here. A companion Law, חוק הגנת הדייר (מוסדות ציבור), exists as a separate Wikisource page and was not verified.

topic_gaps.reason: Only air travel has a compensation statute. The Aviation Services Law covers scheduled and charter flights to, from and within Israel, and it is genuinely strong. There is no equivalent primary statute for rail, bus or light rail: surface passenger rights are set by licence conditions and by subordinate legislation made under the Transport Ordinance (פקודת התעבורה [נוסח חדש]) and the Public Transport rules, plus Ministry of Transport service standards — regulation, not statute. Recorded as a partial gap so nobody looks for a missing Act.

Partial gap, recorded for honesty rather than because an Act is missing. Both Acts listed are the correct primary instruments and both confer the tariff power, but the rules a consumer would actually cite in a billing dispute — meter reading, estimated bills, consumption bands, arrears, deposits, restriction and disconnection of supply — are in Electricity Authority rules (כללי משק החשמל) and Water Authority rules (כללי תאגידי מים וביוב) made under those Acts. An encoding limited to the statutes will capture the institutions and the tariff-setting duty but not the billing entitlements. Telecoms billing is a third strand again, under the Communications (Bezeq and Broadcasts) Law, which is outside this group's topics and was not verified.
